item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe 2-Point Sling delivers exceptional functionality for your shooting needs, with the ability to convert into a single-point sling for enhanced versatility. Made from durable nylon webbing, this sling resists wear and tear while offering long-lasting comfort during use. The bungee material provides flexibility and quick access to your rifle, making it a reliable companion for outdoor activities. Fully adjustable, the sling extends from 50.25 inches to 64.5 inches, fitting most standard-sized long rifles.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe 2-Point Sling delivers exceptional functionality for your shooting needs, with the ability to convert into a single-point sling for enhanced versatility. Made from durable nylon webbing, this sling resists wear and tear while offering long-lasting comfort during use. The bungee material provides flexibility and quick access to your rifle, making it a reliable companion for outdoor activities. Fully adjustable, the sling extends from 50.25 inches to 64.5 inches, fitting most standard-sized long rifles. It also features webbing attachment points for easy setup, fasteners for organizing excess material, and quick-release buckles for effortless mounting and removal. Whether you're at the range or in the field, this sling ensures reliable support and adaptability.
